# StructFuse Related Work Literature Collection

> Collected: 2026-05-16 | Total: 21 papers across 3 directions

---

## Direction 1: Code Retrieval 中的 Negative Mining 策略

### 1.1 CoCoHaNeRe (direct-competitor)

Code search framework with differentiable hard negative retrieval from a searchable memory bank. Average MRR exceeds CodeBERT/GraphCodeBERT/UniXcoder by 11.25%/8.13%/7.38%. **与 StructFuse 最直接的竞品——同样关注 code search 中 hard negative 的挖掘策略。**

```bibtex
@article{fan2025cocohanere,
  title={Effective Hard Negative Mining for Contrastive Learning-Based Code Search},
  author={Fan, Ye and Li, Chao and Ge, Jing and Huang, Liang and Luo, Bin},
  journal={ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology},
  volume={34},
  number={3},
  pages={1--35},
  year={2025},
  doi={10.1145/3695994}
}
```

### 1.2 CodeSearchNet (evaluation)

Code search benchmark with 6M functions across 6 languages and expert relevance annotations. **StructFuse 使用的评估数据集的来源基准。**

```bibtex
@article{husain2019codesearchnet,
  title={CodeSearchNet Challenge: Evaluating the State of Semantic Code Search},
  author={Husain, Hamel and Wu, Ho-Hsiang and Gazit, Tiferet and Allamanis, Miltiadis and Brockschmidt, Marc},
  journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:1909.09436},
  year={2019}
}
```

### 1.3 CodeBERT (background)

First bimodal pre-trained model for programming language and natural language, trained with replaced token detection. **Code retrieval 领域的基线模型。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{feng2020codebert,
  title={CodeBERT: A Pre-Trained Model for Programming and Natural Languages},
  author={Feng, Zhangyin and Guo, Daya and Tang, Duyu and Duan, Nan and Feng, Xiaocheng and Gong, Ming and Shou, Linjun and Qin, Bing and Liu, Ting and Jiang, Daxin and Zhou, Ming},
  booktitle={Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2020},
  pages={1536--1547},
  year={2020}
}
```

### 1.4 GraphCodeBERT (method-component)

First pre-trained model incorporating code structure (data flow) for code representations. Uses semantic-level structure rather than AST. **展示了结构化代码表示对检索的提升，StructFuse 的 structure-aware embedding 思路的先驱。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{guo2021graphcodebert,
  title={GraphCodeBERT: Pre-training Code Representations with Data Flow},
  author={Guo, Daya and Ren, Shuo and Lu, Shuai and Feng, Zhangyin and Tang, Duyu and Liu, Shujie and Zhou, Long and Duan, Nan and Svyatkovskiy, Alexey and Fu, Shengyu and Tufano, Michele and Deng, Shao Kun and Clement, Colin and Drain, Dawn and Sundaresan, Neel and Yin, Jian and Jiang, Daxin and Zhou, Ming},
  booktitle={International Conference on Learning Representations},
  year={2021}
}
```

### 1.5 UniXcoder (background)

Unified cross-modal pre-training leveraging AST and code comments via contrastive learning. **StructFuse 的 backbone encoder 之一，也展示了 AST 结构对代码表示的增益。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{guo2022unixcoder,
  title={UniXcoder: Unified Cross-Modal Pre-training for Code Representation},
  author={Guo, Daya and Lu, Shuai and Duan, Nan and Wang, Yanlin and Zhou, Ming and Yin, Jian},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 60th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)},
  pages={7212--7225},
  year={2022}
}
```

### 1.6 CodeRetriever (direct-competitor)

Large-scale contrastive pre-training with both unimodal (code-code) and bimodal (code-text) learning for code search. **与 StructFuse 类似的 contrastive learning 框架，但没有显式的 hard negative 策略。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{li2022coderetriever,
  title={CodeRetriever: A Large Scale Contrastive Pre-Training Method for Code Search},
  author={Li, Xiaonan and Gong, Yeyun and Shen, Yelong and Qiu, Xipeng and Zhang, Hang and Yao, Bolun and Qi, Weizhen and Jiang, Daxin and Chen, Weizhu and Duan, Nan},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 2022 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing},
  pages={2898--2910},
  year={2022}
}
```

### 1.7 CoCoSoDa (direct-competitor)

Contrastive code search with soft data augmentation and momentum-based negative enrichment. Exceeds CodeBERT/GraphCodeBERT/UniXcoder by 13.3%/10.5%/5.9% MRR. **在 negative sample enrichment 方面与 StructFuse 互补——CoCoSoDa 用 momentum queue 增加 negative 数量，StructFuse 关注 negative difficulty。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{shi2023cocosoda,
  title={CoCoSoDa: Effective Contrastive Learning for Code Search},
  author={Shi, Ensheng and Wang, Yanlin and Gu, Wenchao and Du, Lun and Zhang, Hongyu and Han, Shi and Zhang, Dongmei and Sun, Hongbin},
  booktitle={2023 IEEE/ACM 45th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE)},
  pages={2198--2210},
  year={2023}
}
```

---

## Direction 2: Contrastive Learning 中 Hard Negative 的 Overfitting 问题

### 2.1 CPC / InfoNCE (background)

Introduces InfoNCE loss: contrastive predictive coding for unsupervised representation learning. **Contrastive learning 的基础损失函数，StructFuse 训练目标的理论根基。**

```bibtex
@article{oord2018representation,
  title={Representation Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding},
  author={van den Oord, Aaron and Li, Yazhe and Vinyals, Oriol},
  journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:1807.03748},
  year={2018}
}
```

### 2.2 HCL (method-component)

Develops controllable hard negative sampling for contrastive learning, showing harder negatives accelerate and improve learning. **理论上证明了 hard negative 的价值，但也暗示了过度 hard 会导致问题——StructFuse difficulty analysis 的理论起点。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{robinson2021contrastive,
  title={Contrastive Learning with Hard Negative Samples},
  author={Robinson, Joshua David and Chuang, Ching-Yao and Sra, Suvrit and Jegelka, Stefanie},
  booktitle={International Conference on Learning Representations},
  year={2021}
}
```

### 2.3 DCL (method-component)

Debiased contrastive objective correcting for false negatives (same-class samples treated as negatives). **False negative 是 hard negative 过拟合的重要来源之一，DCL 提供了理论框架。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{chuang2020debiased,
  title={Debiased Contrastive Learning},
  author={Chuang, Ching-Yao and Robinson, Joshua and Lin, Yen-Chen and Torralba, Antonio and Jegelka, Stefanie},
  booktitle={Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems},
  volume={33},
  pages={8765--8775},
  year={2020}
}
```

### 2.4 MoCHi (method-component)

Hard negative mixing at feature level with minimal overhead; shows harder negatives facilitate faster learning. **Feature-level hard negative 合成方法，与 StructFuse 的 structure-based negative mining 形成对比。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{kalantidis2020hard,
  title={Hard Negative Mixing for Contrastive Learning},
  author={Kalantidis, Yannis and Sariyildiz, Mert Bulent and Pion, No{\'e} and Weinzaepfel, Philippe and Larlus, Diane},
  booktitle={Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems},
  volume={33},
  pages={21798--21809},
  year={2020}
}
```

### 2.5 Understanding Hard Negatives in NCE (background)

Theoretical analysis: using model distribution as negative distribution reduces gradient bias. **为 hard negative 的作用提供了理论解释——StructFuse 的 difficulty-overfitting 分析可引用此理论框架。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{zhang2021understanding,
  title={Understanding Hard Negatives in Noise Contrastive Estimation},
  author={Zhang, Wenzheng and Stratos, Karl},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 2021 Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies},
  pages={1090--1101},
  year={2021}
}
```

### 2.6 ProGCL (method-component)

Shows hard negatives in graph CL are often false negatives; proposes probability-based hardness that accounts for true/false negative distinction. **揭示了 hard negative = false negative 的陷阱，与 StructFuse 发现的 difficulty-overfitting 现象呼应。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{xia2022progcl,
  title={ProGCL: Rethinking Hard Negative Mining in Graph Contrastive Learning},
  author={Xia, Jun and Wu, Lirong and Wang, Ge and Chen, Jintao and Li, Stan Z.},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Machine Learning},
  pages={24332--24346},
  year={2022}
}
```

### 2.7 WCL (method-component)

Difficulty-based sampling exploiting a bias-amplifying encoder to find informative hard negatives while avoiding false negatives. **用 difficulty 分层采样来 debias，与 StructFuse 的 difficulty stratification 思路最接近。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{jang2023difficulty,
  title={Difficulty-Based Sampling for Debiased Contrastive Representation Learning},
  author={Jang, Taeuk and Wang, Xiaoqian},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition},
  pages={24039--24048},
  year={2023}
}
```

---

## Direction 3: Representation Geometry / Similarity Saturation

### 3.1 SimCLR (background)

Simple contrastive framework showing the importance of data augmentation, projection head, and batch size. **Contrastive learning 的经典方法论，StructFuse 实验设计的参考。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{chen2020simple,
  title={A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations},
  author={Chen, Ting and Kornblith, Simon and Norouzi, Mohammad and Hinton, Geoffrey},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 37th International Conference on Machine Learning},
  pages={1597--1607},
  year={2020}
}
```

### 3.2 Alignment & Uniformity (method-component)

Identifies two key properties of contrastive loss: alignment of positive pairs and uniformity on hypersphere; proves contrastive loss optimizes both asymptotically. **StructFuse 分析 embedding space 质量的理论工具——可用 alignment/uniformity 指标量化 structure-aware embedding 的改进。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{wang2020understanding,
  title={Understanding Contrastive Representation Learning through Alignment and Uniformity on the Hypersphere},
  author={Wang, Tongzhou and Isola, Phillip},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 37th International Conference on Machine Learning},
  pages={9929--9939},
  year={2020}
}
```

### 3.3 Representation Degeneration (background)

Shows pre-trained LM embeddings degenerate into a narrow cone, limiting representation power; proposes regularization. **Embedding 退化的理论根源——StructFuse 观察到的 similarity saturation 可追溯到此现象。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{gao2019representation,
  title={Representation Degeneration Problem in Training Natural Language Generation Models},
  author={Gao, Jun and He, Di and Tan, Xu and Qin, Tao and Wang, Liwei and Liu, Tie-Yan},
  booktitle={International Conference on Learning Representations},
  year={2019}
}
```

### 3.4 Anisotropy of Contextualized Representations (background)

Discovers that BERT/ELMo/GPT-2 representations occupy a narrow cone (anisotropy) across all layers. **实证发现 pre-trained model 的各向异性问题，StructFuse 使用的 code encoder 继承了此问题。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{ethayarajh2019contextual,
  title={How Contextual are Contextualized Word Representations? Comparing the Geometry of BERT, ELMo, and GPT-2 Embeddings},
  author={Ethayarajh, Kawin},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 2019 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing and the 9th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing},
  pages={55--65},
  year={2019}
}
```

### 3.5 BERT-flow (method-component)

Shows BERT sentence embeddings are anisotropic; proposes normalizing flows to transform to isotropic Gaussian. **Anisotropy 矫正方法的代表，与 StructFuse 的 whitening/normalization 策略形成对比。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{li2020sentence,
  title={On the Sentence Embeddings from Pre-trained Language Models},
  author={Li, Bohan and Zhou, Hao and He, Junxian and Wang, Mingxuan and Yang, Yiming and Li, Lei},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 2020 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing},
  pages={9119--9130},
  year={2020}
}
```

### 3.6 SimCSE (method-component)

Contrastive learning regularizes anisotropic embedding space to be more uniform; uses dropout as minimal augmentation. Spectral analysis shows contrastive loss flattens singular spectrum. **直接证明 contrastive learning 改善 anisotropy——StructFuse 可引用其 uniformity 分析框架。**

```bibtex
@inproceedings{gao2021simcse,
  title={SimCSE: Simple Contrastive Learning of Sentence Embeddings},
  author={Gao, Tianyu and Yao, Xingcheng and Chen, Danqi},
  booktitle={Proceedings of the 2021 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing},
  pages={6894--6910},
  year={2021}
}
```

### 3.7 Whitening for Sentence Representations (method-component)

Whitening operation enhances isotropy and reduces dimensionality of sentence representations. **针对 anisotropy 的简洁解法，与 StructFuse 中 embedding post-processing 的讨论相关。**

```bibtex
@article{su2021whitening,
  title={Whitening Sentence Representations for Better Semantics and Faster Retrieval},
  author={Su, Jianlin and Cao, Jiarun and Liu, Weijie and Ou, Yangyiwen},
  journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2103.15316},
  year={2021}
}
```

---

## Summary

| Direction | Papers | Key insight for StructFuse |
|-----------|--------|---------------------------|
| 1. Code retrieval negative mining | 7 | StructFuse fills the gap between structure-aware encoding (GraphCodeBERT) and hard negative mining (CoCoHaNeRe) by using structural similarity for difficulty-aware negative selection |
| 2. Hard negative overfitting | 7 | Existing work (HCL, DCL, ProGCL, WCL) shows hard negatives help but can cause overfitting/false-negative problems; StructFuse's difficulty stratification addresses this in code domain |
| 3. Representation geometry | 7 | Pre-trained code encoders inherit anisotropy (Ethayarajh, Gao 2019); contrastive learning improves uniformity (SimCSE, Wang & Isola) but similarity saturation in high-similarity regions remains; StructFuse's structure-aware negatives target this specific region |

# Related Work Supplement: Contrastive Learning for Code & Adjacent Areas

> **Purpose**: Supplementary paragraphs and citations to strengthen weak areas in Related Work v1.
> Six new papers added; RocketQA already cited in v1.
> Generated: 2026-05-15

---

## Supplement A: Contrastive Learning for Code (insert into Section 2.2, after the ContraCode/CodeRetriever paragraph)

Beyond learning invariance to syntactic variation, contrastive pre-training has been applied to inject structural and robustness priors into code representations. SynCoBERT \cite{wang2021syncobert} introduces syntax-guided multi-modal contrastive pre-training that aligns code, natural language, and abstract syntax tree (AST) modalities through identifier prediction and AST edge prediction objectives, demonstrating that explicitly encoding syntactic structure during contrastive pre-training improves downstream code intelligence tasks. ContraBERT \cite{liu2023contrabert} takes a complementary robustness-oriented approach, designing nine data augmentation operators that generate adversarial code and comment variants---including identifier renaming, dead code insertion, and operand swapping---and further trains existing code models with contrastive objectives on these augmented pairs. ContraBERT shows that contrastive pre-training with targeted perturbations substantially improves model robustness against adversarial attacks while maintaining strong performance on standard benchmarks. These methods enrich the positive pair construction space for code contrastive learning, yet they focus on augmenting the pre-training signal rather than improving the selection of negative examples during fine-tuning. StructFuse addresses a complementary dimension: rather than improving how positive pairs are constructed, it improves which negatives the model trains against by grounding negative selection in inter-procedural data-flow structure.

## Supplement B: Hard Negative Mining in Dense Retrieval (insert into Section 2.3, after the CL-DRD sentence)

The curriculum learning paradigm for negative sampling has been further developed by CAPSTONE \cite{he2023capstone}, which addresses the training-inference discrepancy in dual-encoder dense retrieval. CAPSTONE expands documents with pseudo-queries during training and employs a curriculum sampling strategy that progressively improves the relevance between generated and real queries, effectively controlling negative difficulty through the query generation quality. This approach achieves strong results on both in-domain and out-of-domain retrieval benchmarks, reinforcing the finding that curriculum-based difficulty scheduling benefits dense retrieval training. While CAPSTONE focuses on bridging the training-inference gap through document expansion, our structure-grounded negatives provide an orthogonal form of curriculum: negatives that are hard because they share data-flow context with the positive, not because of embedding proximity alone.

## Supplement C: Cross-File Code Understanding and Evaluation (insert into Section 2.4, before the closing paragraph, or as a new subsection bridge)

The importance of cross-file context for code understanding has been empirically validated by dedicated benchmarks. CrossCodeEval \cite{ding2023crosscodeeval} constructs a diverse, multilingual benchmark for cross-file code completion across Python, Java, TypeScript, and C\#, using static analysis to identify completion targets that strictly require cross-file dependencies. Experiments show that even state-of-the-art code LLMs struggle without cross-file context, and that retrieval-augmented approaches yield clear improvements---yet performance remains far below the ceiling, indicating substantial room for better cross-file retrieval. ProGraML \cite{cummins2021programl} provides a language-independent, graph-based program representation that captures control-flow, data-flow, and call relations across entire programs, achieving strong results on data-flow analysis tasks. ProGraML demonstrates that whole-program structural representations are learnable and informative, providing conceptual grounding for StructFuse's use of inter-procedural data-flow graphs as a training signal. CoSQA \cite{huang2021cosqa} contributes a large-scale dataset of 20,000+ real web queries paired with Python code, bridging the gap between synthetic code search benchmarks and real-world developer information needs; it also introduces a contrastive learning method (CoCLR) for data augmentation in code search training. Together, these resources underscore that cross-file structural dependencies and realistic query distributions are critical dimensions for advancing code retrieval---precisely the dimensions that StructFuse's structure-grounded training targets.

  # Category 6: Graph-Guided Code Navigation (Inference-Time)
  # ==========================================================================
  graph_guided_inference:
    description: "推理时利用代码结构图辅助导航/检索的方法（与 StructFuse 的训练时结构信号互补）"
    papers:

      - title: "LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization"
        authors: "Zhaoling Chen, Robert Tang, Gangda Deng, Fang Wu, Jialong Wu, Zhiwei Jiang, Viktor Prasanna, Arman Cohan, Xingyao Wang"
        venue: ACL
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "将代码库解析为有向异构图，LLM agent 通过 multi-hop 推理在图上导航做代码定位。推理时用结构图，StructFuse 训练时用。"

      - title: "CodexGraph: Bridging Large Language Models and Code Repositories via Code Graph Databases"
        authors: "Xiangyan Liu, Bo Lan, Zhiyuan Hu, Yang Liu, Zhicheng Zhang, Fei Wang, Michael Qizhe Shieh, Wenmeng Zhou"
        venue: NAACL
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "将代码库索引到图数据库，LLM agent 通过 graph query 接口检索结构化上下文。"

      - title: "RANGER: Repository-Level Agent for Graph-Enhanced Retrieval"
        authors: "Pratik Shah, Rajat Ghosh, Aryan Singhal, Debojyoti Dutta"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "构建 repo 知识图（含 variable-level 节点），dual-stage retrieval: Cypher lookup + MCTS-guided graph exploration。"

      - title: "RepoGraph: Enhancing AI Software Engineering with Repository-level Code Graph"
        authors: "Siru Ouyang, Wenhao Yu, Kaixin Ma, Zilin Xiao, Zhihan Zhang, Mengzhao Jia, Jiawei Han, Hongming Zhang, Dong Yu"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "以代码行为节点构建 repo-level 代码图，作为 SE agent 的 plug-in 导航模块。推理时逐行图导航，与 StructFuse 训练时批量提取结构信号互补。"

      - title: "GraphCoder: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion via Coarse-to-fine Retrieval Based on Code Context Graph"
        authors: "Wei Liu, Ailun Yu, Daoguang Zan, Bo Shen, Wei Zhang, Haiyan Zhao, Zhi Jin, Qianxiang Wang"
        venue: ASE
        year: 2024
        relation: contrast
        summary: "构建 code context graph（含 control-flow 和 data-dependence edges）进行 coarse-to-fine 检索辅助代码补全。使用 intra-procedural data-flow，与 StructFuse 的 inter-procedural scope 形成对比。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 7: Infrastructure / Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  infrastructure:
    description: "StructFuse 依赖的核心基础设施和工具"
    papers:

      - title: "Billion-Scale Similarity Search with GPUs"
        authors: "Jeff Johnson, Matthijs Douze, Herve Jegou"
        venue: "IEEE Transactions on Big Data"
        year: 2021
        relation: building-block
        summary: "FAISS: GPU 加速的大规模向量相似度搜索库，StructFuse 用于 ANN-based hard negative mining。"

      - title: "Tree-sitter: An Incremental Parsing System for Programming Tools"
        authors: "Max Brunsfeld et al."
        venue: "Software (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.13375512)"
        year: 2018
        relation: building-block
        summary: "增量解析库，高效构建和更新 concrete syntax trees。与 CodeQL 互补用于代码结构提取。"
        note: "软件工具，无正式论文。引用 Zenodo DOI 或 GitHub repo。"

      - title: "GRACE: Graph-Guided Repository-Aware Code Completion through Hierarchical Code Fusion"
        authors: "Xingliang Wang, Baoyi Wang, Chen Zhi, Junxiao Han, Xinkui Zhao, Jianwei Yin, Shuiguang Deng"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "构建 repo/module/function 三层多语义代码图（AST + CFG + DFG + call graph + class hierarchy），用 GNN-based hybrid retriever 做层次化检索增强代码补全。推理时图方法，与 StructFuse 训练时结构信号互补。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 7: Representation Geometry / Similarity Saturation
  # ==========================================================================
  representation_geometry:
    description: "预训练模型表示空间几何分析及各向异性修正方法"
    papers:

      - title: "Understanding Contrastive Representation Learning through Alignment and Uniformity on the Hypersphere"
        authors: "Tongzhou Wang, Phillip Isola"
        venue: ICML
        year: 2020
        relation: method-component
        summary: "定义 alignment/uniformity 两个对比学习关键属性，证明对比损失渐近优化两者。StructFuse 分析 embedding space 质量的理论工具。"

      - title: "Representation Degeneration Problem in Training Natural Language Generation Models"
        authors: "Jun Gao, Di He, Xu Tan, Tao Qin, Liwei Wang, Tie-Yan Liu"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "揭示预训练 LM embedding 退化为窄锥的现象，StructFuse 观察到的 similarity saturation 可追溯到此。"

      - title: "How Contextual are Contextualized Word Representations? Comparing the Geometry of BERT, ELMo, and GPT-2 Embeddings"
        authors: "Kawin Ethayarajh"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "实证发现 BERT/ELMo/GPT-2 表示占据窄锥（各向异性），StructFuse 使用的 code encoder 继承此问题。"

      - title: "On the Sentence Embeddings from Pre-trained Language Models"
        authors: "Bohan Li, Hao Zhou, Junxian He, Mingxuan Wang, Yiming Yang, Lei Li"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2020
        relation: method-component
        summary: "BERT-flow: 用 normalizing flows 将各向异性句子嵌入变换为各向同性高斯分布。"

      - title: "SimCSE: Simple Contrastive Learning of Sentence Embeddings"
        authors: "Tianyu Gao, Xingcheng Yao, Danqi Chen"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2021
        relation: method-component
        summary: "用 dropout 作为最小增强的对比学习，直接证明 contrastive learning 改善 anisotropy。StructFuse 可引用其 uniformity 分析框架。"

      - title: "Whitening Sentence Representations for Better Semantics and Faster Retrieval"
        authors: "Jianlin Su, Jiarun Cao, Weijie Liu, Yangyiwen Ou"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2021
        relation: method-component
        summary: "白化操作增强句子表示各向同性并降维，与 StructFuse embedding post-processing 讨论相关。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 8: Infrastructure / Tools

# StructFuse — Related Work Literature Map
# 最后更新: 2026-05-14
# 说明: 只收录已验证存在的论文。每篇均经 WebSearch 确认标题/venue/year。
# 总计: 60 entries (含 2 个软件工具引用)

categories:

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 1: Code Retrieval for Bug Fixing / SWE-bench Ecosystem
  # ==========================================================================
  code_retrieval_bug_fixing:
    description: "SWE-bench 及相关 repo-level 自动修复系统中的代码检索方法"
    papers:

      - title: "SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?"
        authors: "Carlos E. Jimenez, John Yang, Alexander Wettig, Shunyu Yao, Kexin Pei, Ofir Press, Karthik Narasimhan"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2024
        relation: baseline
        summary: "从 GitHub issues 构建 repo-level bug fixing benchmark，成为自动修复领域标准评估集。"

      - title: "SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering"
        authors: "John Yang, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kilian Lieret, Shunyu Yao, Karthik Narasimhan, Ofir Press"
        venue: NeurIPS
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "基于 LLM agent 的交互式 bug fixing 系统，定义了 ACI 接口范式。"

      - title: "AutoCodeRover: Autonomous Program Improvement"
        authors: "Yuntong Zhang, Haifeng Ruan, Zhiyu Fan, Abhik Roychoudhury"
        venue: ISSTA
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "结合代码搜索与 spectrum-based fault localization，利用程序分析缩小修复范围。"

      - title: "Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents"
        authors: "Chunqiu Steven Xia, Yinlin Deng, Soren Dunn, Lingming Zhang"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "无 agent 架构的 two-phase localize-then-repair 方法，在 SWE-bench 上取得强 baseline。"

      - title: "SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents"
        authors: "John Yang, Kilian Lieret, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kabir Khandpur, Yanzhe Zhang, Binyuan Hui, Ofir Press, Ludwig Schmidt, Diyi Yang"
        venue: "NeurIPS (Datasets & Benchmarks, Spotlight)"
        year: 2025
        relation: building-block
        summary: "自动从 GitHub 生成大规模 SWE-bench 风格训练数据，StructFuse 用其 repos 做 data-flow 提取。"

      - title: "RepoBench: Benchmarking Repository-Level Code Auto-Completion Systems"
        authors: "Tianyang Liu, Canwen Xu, Julian McAuley"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2024
        relation: baseline
        summary: "Repo-level 代码补全/检索 benchmark，含 RepoBench-R 检索子任务。"

      - title: "SweRank: Software Issue Localization with Code Ranking"
        authors: "Revanth Gangi Reddy, Tarun Suresh, JaeHyeok Doo, Ye Liu, Xuan Phi Nguyen, Yingbo Zhou, Semih Yavuz, Caiming Xiong, Heng Ji, Shafiq Joty"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: competitor
        summary: "Retrieve-and-rerank 框架用于 software issue localization，在 SWE-Bench-Lite 和 LocBench 上 SOTA，text-based retrieval baseline。"

      - title: "SWE-Fixer: Training Open-Source LLMs for Effective and Efficient GitHub Issue Resolution"
        authors: "Chengxing Xie, Bowen Li, Chang Gao, He Du, Wai Lam, Difan Zou, Kai Chen"
        venue: "ACL (Findings)"
        year: 2025
        relation: competitor
        summary: "BM25 + LLM retriever 的 coarse-to-fine file retrieval pipeline，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上 30.2%。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 2: Hard Negative Mining in Contrastive Learning
  # ==========================================================================
  hard_negative_mining:
    description: "对比学习中 hard negative 挖掘策略，以及密集检索中的负样本选择"
    papers:

      - title: "Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering"
        authors: "Vladimir Karpukhin, Barlas Oguz, Sewon Min, Patrick Lewis, Ledell Wu, Sergey Edunov, Danqi Chen, Wen-tau Yih"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "DPR 开创了 in-batch negatives + BM25 hard negatives 的双塔检索范式。"

      - title: "Approximate Nearest Neighbor Negative Contrastive Learning for Dense Text Retrieval"
        authors: "Lee Xiong, Chenyan Xiong, Ye Li, Kwok-Fung Tang, Jialin Liu, Paul Bennett, Junaid Ahmed, Arnold Overwijk"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "ANCE 用 ANN index 动态挖掘 embedding-distance hard negatives，StructFuse 的 baseline negative 策略之一。"

      - title: "A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations"
        authors: "Ting Chen, Simon Kornblith, Mohammad Norouzi, Geoffrey Hinton"
        venue: ICML
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "SimCLR 视觉对比学习奠基工作，证明 hard negatives 和大 batch size 对对比学习的重要性。"

      - title: "Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks"
        authors: "Nils Reimers, Iryna Gurevych"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "Siamese/triplet 网络训练句子嵌入，StructFuse 的对比训练框架与其类似。"

      - title: "Curriculum Learning for Dense Retrieval Distillation"
        authors: "Hansi Zeng, Hamed Zamani, Vishwa Vinay"
        venue: "SIGIR (Best Short Paper)"
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "CL-DRD: 课程学习式知识蒸馏用于密集检索，从粗粒度到细粒度逐步增加训练难度。"

      - title: "Effective Hard Negative Mining for Contrastive Learning-Based Code Search"
        authors: "Fan Y., Li C., Ge J., Huang L., Luo B."
        venue: "ACM TOSEM"
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast-target
        summary: "CoCoHaNeRe: 提出可微分 hard negative 机制用于代码搜索对比学习。其对 hard negative 机制的处理与 StructFuse 的发现形成关键对照——StructFuse 证明 true embedding-distance mining 即可持续提升性能。"
        note: "关键引用：StructFuse Claim 1 的 correction target。CoCoHaNeRe 论点是非可微 embedding negatives 学习'slow and ineffective'，StructFuse 证明用 true embedding distance mining 仍然有效。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 3: Contrastive Learning for Code
  # ==========================================================================
  contrastive_code_learning:
    description: "代码领域的对比学习方法，训练时利用代码特性构建正负样本"
    papers:

      - title: "Contrastive Code Representation Learning"
        authors: "Paras Jain, Ajay Jain, Tianjun Zhang, Pieter Abbeel, Joseph Gonzalez, Ion Stoica"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "ContraCode: 自监督对比预训练，通过编译器变换生成功能等价的程序变体，学习代码功能而非表面形式。"

      - title: "CodeRetriever: A Large Scale Contrastive Pre-Training Method for Code Search"
        authors: "Xiaonan Li, Yeyun Gong, Yelong Shen, Xipeng Qiu, Hang Zhang, Bolun Yao, Weizhen Qi, Daxin Jiang, Weizhu Chen, Nan Duan"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "结合 unimodal (code-code) 和 bimodal (code-text) 对比学习预训练代码表示，在 11 个代码搜索 benchmark 上 SOTA。"

      - title: "Towards Learning (Dis)-Similarity of Source Code from Program Contrasts"
        authors: "Yangruibo Ding, Luca Buratti, Saurabh Pujar, Alessandro Morari, Baishakhi Ray, Saikat Chakraborty"
        venue: "ACL (Long Papers)"
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "利用程序结构和功能属性构建对比样本对，学习代码相似性/差异性表示。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 4: Program Analysis for ML
  # ==========================================================================
  program_analysis_for_ml:
    description: "静态分析辅助 ML，结构信息在代码表示学习中的应用"
    papers:

      - title: "CodeQL: Semantic Code Analysis Engine"
        authors: "GitHub / Semmle"
        venue: "Tool (open-source)"
        year: 2019
        relation: building-block
        summary: "基于 Datalog 的代码查询引擎，支持 inter-procedural data-flow 分析。StructFuse 用它提取 scope-bounded data-flow graph。"

      - title: "code2vec: Learning Distributed Representations of Code"
        authors: "Uri Alon, Meital Zilberstein, Omer Levy, Eran Yahav"
        venue: POPL
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "用 AST path 学习代码向量表示，首次大规模证明结构信息对代码表示学习的价值。"

      - title: "code2seq: Generating Sequences from Structured Representations of Code"
        authors: "Uri Alon, Shaked Brody, Omer Levy, Eran Yahav"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "code2vec 的序列生成扩展，用 AST path attention 生成方法名摘要。"

      - title: "Detecting Code Clones with Graph Neural Network and Flow-Augmented Abstract Syntax Tree"
        authors: "Wenhan Wang, Ge Li, Bo Ma, Xin Xia, Zhi Jin"
        venue: SANER
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "FA-AST: 用 data-flow 增强 AST 进行代码克隆检测，与 StructFuse 用 data-flow 做 hard negative 挖掘思路相关。"

      - title: "GraphCodeBERT: Pre-training Code Representations with Data Flow"
        authors: "Daya Guo, Shuo Ren, Shuai Lu, Zhangyin Feng, Duyu Tang, Shujie Liu, Long Zhou, Nan Duan, Alexey Svyatkovskiy, Shengyu Fu, Michele Tufano, Shao Kun Deng, Colin Clement, Dawn Drain, Neel Sundaresan, Jian Yin, Daxin Jiang, Ming Zhou"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "在预训练中引入 data-flow edge，证明 data-flow 信息提升代码理解任务。StructFuse 的 insight 与此相关但用途不同（hard negative mining vs pre-training）。"

      - title: "ARISE: A Repository-level Graph Representation and Toolset for Agentic Fault Localization and Program Repair"
        authors: "Shahd Seddik, Fatemeh Fard"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2026
        relation: contrast
        summary: "用 multi-granularity program graph（含 intra-procedural def-use edges）辅助 LLM agent 做 fault localization。仅 intra-procedural + runtime tool calls，与 StructFuse 的 inter-procedural static mining 互补。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 5: Code Embeddings / Code Search
  # ==========================================================================
  code_embeddings_search:
    description: "代码嵌入模型和代码搜索方法"
    papers:

      - title: "CodeSearchNet Challenge: Evaluating the State of Semantic Code Search"
        authors: "Hamel Husain, Ho-Hsiang Wu, Tiferet Gazit, Miltiadis Allamanis, Marc Brockschmidt"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "代码语义搜索 benchmark 和数据集，推动了代码嵌入模型的发展。"

      - title: "CodeBERT: A Pre-Trained Model for Programming and Natural Languages"
        authors: "Zhangyin Feng, Daya Guo, Duyu Tang, Nan Duan, Xiaocheng Feng, Ming Gong, Lixin Zou, Bing Qin, Ting Liu, Daxin Jiang, Ming Zhou"
        venue: "EMNLP (Findings)"
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "首个编程语言-自然语言双模态预训练模型，代码嵌入的早期里程碑。"

      - title: "UniXcoder: Unified Cross-Modal Pre-training for Code Representation"
        authors: "Daya Guo, Shuai Lu, Nan Duan, Yanlin Wang, Ming Zhou, Jian Yin"
        venue: ACL
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "统一跨模态代码预训练，在代码搜索等任务上取得 SOTA。"

      - title: "StarCoder: May the Source Be with You!"
        authors: "Raymond Li, Loubna Ben Allal, et al. (BigCode)"
        venue: TMLR
        year: 2023
        relation: building-block
        summary: "大规模开源代码 LLM，StructFuse 用 StarCoder2-3B 作为对比学习检索器的 backbone 之一。"

      - title: "Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code"
        authors: "Baptiste Roziere, Jonas Gehring, Fabian Gloeckle, et al. (Meta AI)"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2023
        relation: background
        summary: "Meta 的代码大模型系列，基于 Llama 2 微调。"

      - title: "Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report"
        authors: "Binyuan Hui, Jian Yang, Zeyu Cui, et al. (Qwen Team, Alibaba)"
        venue: arXiv

        summary: "白化操作增强句子表示各向同性并降维，与 StructFuse embedding post-processing 讨论相关。"

# StructFuse — Related Work Literature Map
# 最后更新: 2026-05-14

categories:

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 1: Code Retrieval for Bug Fixing / SWE-bench Ecosystem
  # ==========================================================================
  code_retrieval_bug_fixing:
    description: "SWE-bench 及相关 repo-level 自动修复系统中的代码检索方法"
    papers:

      - title: "SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?"
        authors: "Carlos E. Jimenez, John Yang, Alexander Wettig, Shunyu Yao, Kexin Pei, Ofir Press, Karthik Narasimhan"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2024
        relation: baseline
        summary: "从 GitHub issues 构建 repo-level bug fixing benchmark，成为自动修复领域标准评估集。"

      - title: "SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering"
        authors: "John Yang, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kilian Lieret, Shunyu Yao, Karthik Narasimhan, Ofir Press"
        venue: NeurIPS
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "基于 LLM agent 的交互式 bug fixing 系统，定义了 ACI 接口范式。"

      - title: "AutoCodeRover: Autonomous Program Improvement"
        authors: "Yuntong Zhang, Haifeng Ruan, Zhiyu Fan, Abhik Roychoudhury"
        venue: ISSTA
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "结合代码搜索与 spectrum-based fault localization，利用程序分析缩小修复范围。"

      - title: "Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents"
        authors: "Chunqiu Steven Xia, Yinlin Deng, Soren Dunn, Lingming Zhang"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "无 agent 架构的 two-phase localize-then-repair 方法，在 SWE-bench 上取得强 baseline。"

      - title: "SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents"
        authors: "John Yang, Kilian Lieret, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kabir Khandpur, Yanzhe Zhang, Binyuan Hui, Ofir Press, Ludwig Schmidt, Diyi Yang"
        venue: "NeurIPS (Datasets & Benchmarks, Spotlight)"
        year: 2025
        relation: building-block
        summary: "自动从 GitHub 生成大规模 SWE-bench 风格训练数据，StructFuse 用其 repos 做 data-flow 提取。"

      - title: "RepoBench: Benchmarking Repository-Level Code Auto-Completion Systems"
        authors: "Tianyang Liu, Canwen Xu, Julian McAuley"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2024
        relation: baseline
        summary: "Repo-level 代码补全/检索 benchmark，含 RepoBench-R 检索子任务。"

      - title: "SweRank: Software Issue Localization with Code Ranking"
        authors: "Revanth Gangi Reddy, Tarun Suresh, JaeHyeok Doo, Ye Liu, Xuan Phi Nguyen, Yingbo Zhou, Semih Yavuz, Caiming Xiong, Heng Ji, Shafiq Joty"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: competitor
        summary: "Retrieve-and-rerank 框架用于 software issue localization，在 SWE-Bench-Lite 和 LocBench 上 SOTA，text-based retrieval baseline。"

      - title: "SWE-Fixer: Training Open-Source LLMs for Effective and Efficient GitHub Issue Resolution"
        authors: "Chengxing Xie, Bowen Li, Chang Gao, He Du, Wai Lam, Difan Zou, Kai Chen"
        venue: "ACL (Findings)"
        year: 2025
        relation: competitor
        summary: "BM25 + LLM retriever 的 coarse-to-fine file retrieval pipeline，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上 30.2%。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 2: Hard Negative Mining in Contrastive Learning
  # ==========================================================================
  hard_negative_mining:
    description: "对比学习中 hard negative 挖掘策略，以及密集检索中的负样本选择"
    papers:

      - title: "Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering"

        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "DPR 开创了 in-batch negatives + BM25 hard negatives 的双塔检索范式。"

      - title: "Approximate Nearest Neighbor Negative Contrastive Learning for Dense Text Retrieval"
        authors: "Lee Xiong, Chenyan Xiong, Ye Li, Kwok-Fung Tang, Jialin Liu, Paul Bennett, Junaid Ahmed, Arnold Overwijk"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "ANCE 用 ANN index 动态挖掘 embedding-distance hard negatives，StructFuse 的 baseline negative 策略之一。"

      - title: "A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations"
        authors: "Ting Chen, Simon Kornblith, Mohammad Norouzi, Geoffrey Hinton"
        venue: ICML
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "SimCLR 视觉对比学习奠基工作，证明 hard negatives 和大 batch size 对对比学习的重要性。"

      - title: "Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks"
        authors: "Nils Reimers, Iryna Gurevych"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "Siamese/triplet 网络训练句子嵌入，StructFuse 的对比训练框架与其类似。"

      - title: "Curriculum Learning for Dense Retrieval Distillation"
        authors: "Hansi Zeng, Hamed Zamani, Vishwa Vinay"
        venue: "SIGIR (Best Short Paper)"
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "CL-DRD: 课程学习式知识蒸馏用于密集检索，从粗粒度到细粒度逐步增加训练难度。"

      - title: "Effective Hard Negative Mining for Contrastive Learning-Based Code Search"
        authors: "Fan Y., Li C., Ge J., Huang L., Luo B."
        venue: "ACM TOSEM"
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast-target
        summary: "CoCoHaNeRe: 提出可微分 hard negative 机制用于代码搜索对比学习。其对 hard negative 机制的处理与 StructFuse 的发现形成关键对照——StructFuse 证明 true embedding-distance mining 即可持续提升性能。"
        note: "关键引用：StructFuse Claim 1 的 correction target。CoCoHaNeRe 论点是非可微 embedding negatives 学习'slow and ineffective'，StructFuse 证明用 true embedding distance mining 仍然有效。"

  # Category 3: Contrastive Learning for Code
  # ==========================================================================

        authors: "Paras Jain, Ajay Jain, Tianjun Zhang, Pieter Abbeel, Joseph Gonzalez, Ion Stoica"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "ContraCode: 自监督对比预训练，通过编译器变换生成功能等价的程序变体，学习代码功能而非表面形式。"

      - title: "Towards Learning (Dis)-Similarity of Source Code from Program Contrasts"
        authors: "Yangruibo Ding, Luca Buratti, Saurabh Pujar, Alessandro Morari, Baishakhi Ray, Saikat Chakraborty"
        venue: "ACL (Long Papers)"
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "利用程序结构和功能属性构建对比样本对，学习代码相似性/差异性表示。"

        year: 2019
        relation: background

        year: 2024

        year: 2021
        relation: method-component
        summary: "白化操作增强句子表示各向同性并降维，与 StructFuse embedding post-processing 讨论相关。"

# StructFuse — Related Work Literature Map
# 最后更新: 2026-05-14
# 说明: 只收录已验证存在的论文。每篇均经 WebSearch 确认标题/venue/year。

categories:

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 1: Code Retrieval for Bug Fixing / SWE-bench Ecosystem
  # ==========================================================================
  code_retrieval_bug_fixing:
    description: "SWE-bench 及相关 repo-level 自动修复系统中的代码检索方法"
    papers:

      - title: "SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?"
        authors: "Carlos E. Jimenez, John Yang, Alexander Wettig, Shunyu Yao, Kexin Pei, Ofir Press, Karthik Narasimhan"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2024
        relation: baseline
        summary: "从 GitHub issues 构建 repo-level bug fixing benchmark，成为自动修复领域标准评估集。"

      - title: "SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering"
        authors: "John Yang, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kilian Lieret, Shunyu Yao, Karthik Narasimhan, Ofir Press"
        venue: NeurIPS
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "基于 LLM agent 的交互式 bug fixing 系统，定义了 ACI 接口范式。"

      - title: "AutoCodeRover: Autonomous Program Improvement"
        authors: "Yuntong Zhang, Haifeng Ruan, Zhiyu Fan, Abhik Roychoudhury"
        venue: ISSTA
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "结合代码搜索与 spectrum-based fault localization，利用程序分析缩小修复范围。"

      - title: "Agentless: Demystifying LLM-based Software Engineering Agents"
        authors: "Chunqiu Steven Xia, Yinlin Deng, Soren Dunn, Lingming Zhang"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2024
        relation: competitor
        summary: "无 agent 架构的 two-phase localize-then-repair 方法，在 SWE-bench 上取得强 baseline。"

      - title: "SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents"
        authors: "John Yang, Kilian Lieret, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kabir Khandpur, Yanzhe Zhang, Binyuan Hui, Ofir Press, Ludwig Schmidt, Diyi Yang"
        venue: "NeurIPS (Datasets & Benchmarks, Spotlight)"
        year: 2025
        relation: building-block
        summary: "自动从 GitHub 生成大规模 SWE-bench 风格训练数据，StructFuse 用其 repos 做 data-flow 提取。"

      - title: "RepoBench: Benchmarking Repository-Level Code Auto-Completion Systems"
        authors: "Tianyang Liu, Canwen Xu, Julian McAuley"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2024
        relation: baseline
        summary: "Repo-level 代码补全/检索 benchmark，含 RepoBench-R 检索子任务。"

      - title: "SweRank: Software Issue Localization with Code Ranking"
        authors: "Revanth Gangi Reddy, Tarun Suresh, JaeHyeok Doo, Ye Liu, Xuan Phi Nguyen, Yingbo Zhou, Semih Yavuz, Caiming Xiong, Heng Ji, Shafiq Joty"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: competitor
        summary: "Retrieve-and-rerank 框架用于 software issue localization，在 SWE-Bench-Lite 和 LocBench 上 SOTA，text-based retrieval baseline。"

      - title: "SWE-Fixer: Training Open-Source LLMs for Effective and Efficient GitHub Issue Resolution"
        authors: "Chengxing Xie, Bowen Li, Chang Gao, He Du, Wai Lam, Difan Zou, Kai Chen"
        venue: "ACL (Findings)"
        year: 2025
        relation: competitor
        summary: "BM25 + LLM retriever 的 coarse-to-fine file retrieval pipeline，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上 30.2%。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 2: Hard Negative Mining in Contrastive Learning
  # ==========================================================================
  hard_negative_mining:
    description: "对比学习中 hard negative 挖掘策略，以及密集检索中的负样本选择"
    papers:

      - title: "Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering"
        authors: "Vladimir Karpukhin, Barlas Oguz, Sewon Min, Patrick Lewis, Ledell Wu, Sergey Edunov, Danqi Chen, Wen-tau Yih"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "DPR 开创了 in-batch negatives + BM25 hard negatives 的双塔检索范式。"

      - title: "Approximate Nearest Neighbor Negative Contrastive Learning for Dense Text Retrieval"
        authors: "Lee Xiong, Chenyan Xiong, Ye Li, Kwok-Fung Tang, Jialin Liu, Paul Bennett, Junaid Ahmed, Arnold Overwijk"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "ANCE 用 ANN index 动态挖掘 embedding-distance hard negatives，StructFuse 的 baseline negative 策略之一。"

      - title: "A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations"
        authors: "Ting Chen, Simon Kornblith, Mohammad Norouzi, Geoffrey Hinton"
        venue: ICML
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "SimCLR 视觉对比学习奠基工作，证明 hard negatives 和大 batch size 对对比学习的重要性。"

      - title: "Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks"
        authors: "Nils Reimers, Iryna Gurevych"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "Siamese/triplet 网络训练句子嵌入，StructFuse 的对比训练框架与其类似。"

      - title: "Curriculum Learning for Dense Retrieval Distillation"
        authors: "Hansi Zeng, Hamed Zamani, Vishwa Vinay"
        venue: "SIGIR (Best Short Paper)"
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "CL-DRD: 课程学习式知识蒸馏用于密集检索，从粗粒度到细粒度逐步增加训练难度。"

      - title: "Effective Hard Negative Mining for Contrastive Learning-Based Code Search"
        authors: "Fan Y., Li C., Ge J., Huang L., Luo B."
        venue: "ACM TOSEM"
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast-target
        summary: "CoCoHaNeRe: 提出可微分 hard negative 机制用于代码搜索对比学习。其对 hard negative 机制的处理与 StructFuse 的发现形成关键对照——StructFuse 证明 true embedding-distance mining 即可持续提升性能。"
        note: "关键引用：StructFuse Claim 1 的 correction target。CoCoHaNeRe 论点是非可微 embedding negatives 学习'slow and ineffective'，StructFuse 证明用 true embedding distance mining 仍然有效。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 3: Contrastive Learning for Code
  # ==========================================================================
  contrastive_code_learning:
    description: "代码领域的对比学习方法，训练时利用代码特性构建正负样本"
    papers:

      - title: "Contrastive Code Representation Learning"
        authors: "Paras Jain, Ajay Jain, Tianjun Zhang, Pieter Abbeel, Joseph Gonzalez, Ion Stoica"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "ContraCode: 自监督对比预训练，通过编译器变换生成功能等价的程序变体，学习代码功能而非表面形式。"

      - title: "CodeRetriever: A Large Scale Contrastive Pre-Training Method for Code Search"

        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "结合 unimodal (code-code) 和 bimodal (code-text) 对比学习预训练代码表示，在 11 个代码搜索 benchmark 上 SOTA。"

      - title: "Towards Learning (Dis)-Similarity of Source Code from Program Contrasts"
        authors: "Yangruibo Ding, Luca Buratti, Saurabh Pujar, Alessandro Morari, Baishakhi Ray, Saikat Chakraborty"
        venue: "ACL (Long Papers)"
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "利用程序结构和功能属性构建对比样本对，学习代码相似性/差异性表示。"

        relation: background

        relation: background

        authors: "Chris Cummins, Zacharias V. Fisches, Tal Ben-Nun, Torsten Hoefler, Michael FP O'Boyle, Hugh Leather"

        year: 2021

        summary: "语言无关的全程序图表示（control-flow + data-flow + call relations），证明整程序结构表示可学习且有效。StructFuse 使用 inter-procedural data-flow 的概念根基。"

        authors: "Yangruibo Ding, Zijian Wang, Wasi Uddin Ahmad, Hantian Ding, Ming Tan, Nihal Jain, Murali Krishna Ramanathan, Ramesh Nallapati, Parminder Bhatia, Dan Roth, Bing Xiang"

        year: 2023
        relation: background
        summary: "多语言 cross-file 代码补全 benchmark，用静态分析确定需 cross-file 依赖的补全目标。验证了跨文件上下文对代码任务的关键性。"

        authors: "Zhangyin Feng, Daya Guo, Duyu Tang, Nan Duan, Xiaocheng Feng, Ming Gong, Lixin Zou, Bing Qin, Ting Liu, Daxin Jiang, Ming Zhou"
        venue: "EMNLP (Findings)"
        year: 2020
        relation: background
        summary: "首个编程语言-自然语言双模态预训练模型，代码嵌入的早期里程碑。"

      - title: "UniXcoder: Unified Cross-Modal Pre-training for Code Representation"
        authors: "Daya Guo, Shuai Lu, Nan Duan, Yanlin Wang, Ming Zhou, Jian Yin"
        venue: ACL
        year: 2022
        relation: background
        summary: "统一跨模态代码预训练，在代码搜索等任务上取得 SOTA。"

      - title: "StarCoder: May the Source Be with You!"
        authors: "Raymond Li, Loubna Ben Allal, et al. (BigCode)"
        venue: TMLR
        year: 2023
        relation: building-block
        summary: "大规模开源代码 LLM，StructFuse 用 StarCoder2-3B 作为对比学习检索器的 backbone 之一。"

      - title: "Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code"
        authors: "Baptiste Roziere, Jonas Gehring, Fabian Gloeckle, et al. (Meta AI)"

        relation: background

        venue: arXiv
        year: 2024
        relation: background

        authors: "Disha Shrivastava, Denis Kocetkov, Harm de Vries, Dzmitry Bahdanau, Torsten Scholak"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2023
        relation: background

        authors: "Stephen Robertson, Hugo Zaragoza"
        venue: "Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval"
        year: 2009
        relation: baseline
        summary: "经典稀疏检索方法，StructFuse 的 baseline 之一。"

        authors: "Junjie Huang, Duyu Tang, Linjun Shou, Ming Gong, Ke Xu, Daxin Jiang, Ming Zhou, Nan Duan"
        venue: ACL
        year: 2021
        relation: background

  # Category 6: Graph-Guided Code Navigation (Inference-Time)

  graph_guided_inference:
    description: "推理时利用代码结构图辅助导航/检索的方法（与 StructFuse 的训练时结构信号互补）"
    papers:

      - title: "LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization"
        authors: "Zhaoling Chen, Robert Tang, Gangda Deng, Fang Wu, Jialong Wu, Zhiwei Jiang, Viktor Prasanna, Arman Cohan, Xingyao Wang"
        venue: ACL
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast

        authors: "Xiangyan Liu, Bo Lan, Zhiyuan Hu, Yang Liu, Zhicheng Zhang, Fei Wang, Michael Qizhe Shieh, Wenmeng Zhou"
        venue: NAACL
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast

        authors: "Pratik Shah, Rajat Ghosh, Aryan Singhal, Debojyoti Dutta"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "构建 repo 知识图（含 variable-level 节点），dual-stage retrieval: Cypher lookup + MCTS-guided graph exploration。"

      - title: "RepoGraph: Enhancing AI Software Engineering with Repository-level Code Graph"
        authors: "Siru Ouyang, Wenhao Yu, Kaixin Ma, Zilin Xiao, Zhihan Zhang, Mengzhao Jia, Jiawei Han, Hongming Zhang, Dong Yu"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "以代码行为节点构建 repo-level 代码图，作为 SE agent 的 plug-in 导航模块。推理时逐行图导航，与 StructFuse 训练时批量提取结构信号互补。"

      - title: "GraphCoder: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion via Coarse-to-fine Retrieval Based on Code Context Graph"
        authors: "Wei Liu, Ailun Yu, Daoguang Zan, Bo Shen, Wei Zhang, Haiyan Zhao, Zhi Jin, Qianxiang Wang"
        venue: ASE
        year: 2024
        relation: contrast
        summary: "构建 code context graph（含 control-flow 和 data-dependence edges）进行 coarse-to-fine 检索辅助代码补全。使用 intra-procedural data-flow，与 StructFuse 的 inter-procedural scope 形成对比。"

      - title: "GRACE: Graph-Guided Repository-Aware Code Completion through Hierarchical Code Fusion"
        authors: "Xingliang Wang, Baoyi Wang, Chen Zhi, Junxiao Han, Xinkui Zhao, Jianwei Yin, Shuiguang Deng"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2025
        relation: contrast
        summary: "构建 repo/module/function 三层多语义代码图（AST + CFG + DFG + call graph + class hierarchy），用 GNN-based hybrid retriever 做层次化检索增强代码补全。推理时图方法，与 StructFuse 训练时结构信号互补。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 7: Representation Geometry / Similarity Saturation
  # ==========================================================================
  representation_geometry:
    description: "预训练模型表示空间几何分析及各向异性修正方法"
    papers:

      - title: "Understanding Contrastive Representation Learning through Alignment and Uniformity on the Hypersphere"
        authors: "Tongzhou Wang, Phillip Isola"
        venue: ICML
        year: 2020
        relation: method-component
        summary: "定义 alignment/uniformity 两个对比学习关键属性，证明对比损失渐近优化两者。StructFuse 分析 embedding space 质量的理论工具。"

      - title: "Representation Degeneration Problem in Training Natural Language Generation Models"
        authors: "Jun Gao, Di He, Xu Tan, Tao Qin, Liwei Wang, Tie-Yan Liu"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "揭示预训练 LM embedding 退化为窄锥的现象，StructFuse 观察到的 similarity saturation 可追溯到此。"

      - title: "How Contextual are Contextualized Word Representations? Comparing the Geometry of BERT, ELMo, and GPT-2 Embeddings"
        authors: "Kawin Ethayarajh"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2019
        relation: background
        summary: "实证发现 BERT/ELMo/GPT-2 表示占据窄锥（各向异性），StructFuse 使用的 code encoder 继承此问题。"

      - title: "On the Sentence Embeddings from Pre-trained Language Models"
        authors: "Bohan Li, Hao Zhou, Junxian He, Mingxuan Wang, Yiming Yang, Lei Li"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2020
        relation: method-component
        summary: "BERT-flow: 用 normalizing flows 将各向异性句子嵌入变换为各向同性高斯分布。"

      - title: "SimCSE: Simple Contrastive Learning of Sentence Embeddings"
        authors: "Tianyu Gao, Xingcheng Yao, Danqi Chen"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2021
        relation: method-component
        summary: "用 dropout 作为最小增强的对比学习，直接证明 contrastive learning 改善 anisotropy。StructFuse 可引用其 uniformity 分析框架。"

      - title: "Whitening Sentence Representations for Better Semantics and Faster Retrieval"
        authors: "Jianlin Su, Jiarun Cao, Weijie Liu, Yangyiwen Ou"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2021
        relation: method-component
        summary: "白化操作增强句子表示各向同性并降维，与 StructFuse embedding post-processing 讨论相关。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 8: Infrastructure / Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  infrastructure:
    description: "StructFuse 依赖的核心基础设施和工具"
    papers:

      - title: "Billion-Scale Similarity Search with GPUs"
        authors: "Jeff Johnson, Matthijs Douze, Herve Jegou"
        venue: "IEEE Transactions on Big Data"
        year: 2021
        relation: building-block
        summary: "FAISS: GPU 加速的大规模向量相似度搜索库，StructFuse 用于 ANN-based hard negative mining。"

        authors: "Max Brunsfeld et al."

        relation: building-block
        summary: "增量解析库，高效构建和更新 concrete syntax trees。与 CodeQL 互补用于代码结构提取。"

note: "关键引用：StructFuse Claim 1 的 correction target。CoCoHaNeRe 论点是非可微 embedding negatives 学习'slow and ineffective'，StructFuse 证明用 true embedding distance mining 仍然有效。"

      - title: "Representation Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding"
        authors: "Aaron van den Oord, Yazhe Li, Oriol Vinyals"
        venue: arXiv
        year: 2018
        relation: background
        summary: "InfoNCE 损失函数：对比预测编码的无监督表示学习。StructFuse 训练目标的理论根基。"

      - title: "Contrastive Learning with Hard Negative Samples"
        authors: "Joshua David Robinson, Ching-Yao Chuang, Suvrit Sra, Stefanie Jegelka"
        venue: ICLR
        year: 2021
        relation: method-component
        summary: "HCL: 可控 hard negative 采样，证明更难的 negatives 加速和改善学习，但暗示过度 hard 会导致问题。StructFuse difficulty analysis 的理论起点。"

      - title: "Debiased Contrastive Learning"
        authors: "Ching-Yao Chuang, Joshua Robinson, Yen-Chen Lin, Antonio Torralba, Stefanie Jegelka"
        venue: NeurIPS
        year: 2020
        relation: method-component
        summary: "DCL: 去偏对比目标，修正 false negatives（同类样本被当作 negatives）问题。False negative 是 hard negative 过拟合的重要来源。"

      - title: "Hard Negative Mixing for Contrastive Learning"
        authors: "Yannis Kalantidis, Mert Bulent Sariyildiz, Noe Pion, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Diane Larlus"
        venue: NeurIPS
        year: 2020
        relation: method-component
        summary: "MoCHi: feature-level hard negative 混合合成，开销极小。与 StructFuse 的 structure-based negative mining 形成对比。"

      - title: "Understanding Hard Negatives in Noise Contrastive Estimation"
        authors: "Wenzheng Zhang, Karl Stratos"
        venue: NAACL
        year: 2021
        relation: background
        summary: "理论分析：用模型分布作为 negative 分布可减少梯度偏差。为 hard negative 作用提供理论解释。"

      - title: "ProGCL: Rethinking Hard Negative Mining in Graph Contrastive Learning"
        authors: "Jun Xia, Lirong Wu, Ge Wang, Jintao Chen, Stan Z. Li"
        venue: ICML
        year: 2022
        relation: method-component
        summary: "揭示图对比学习中 hard negative = false negative 的陷阱，提出基于概率的 hardness 区分 true/false negatives。与 StructFuse difficulty-overfitting 发现呼应。"

      - title: "Difficulty-Based Sampling for Debiased Contrastive Representation Learning"
        authors: "Taeuk Jang, Xiaoqian Wang"
        venue: CVPR
        year: 2023
        relation: method-component
        summary: "WCL: 用 difficulty 分层采样 + bias-amplifying encoder 找信息性 hard negatives 同时避免 false negatives。与 StructFuse difficulty stratification 思路最接近。"

      - title: "CAPSTONE: Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document Expansion"
        authors: "Xingwei He, Yeyun Gong, A-Long Jin, Hang Zhang, Anlei Dong, Jian Jiao, Siu Ming Yiu, Nan Duan"
        venue: EMNLP
        year: 2023
        relation: background
        summary: "课程采样策略 + pseudo-query 文档扩展，解决双塔检索训练-推理差异。StructFuse 的 structure-grounded negatives 提供正交的课程形式。"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Category 3: Contrastive Learning for Code

    papers:

content.content: 15:The curriculum learning paradigm for negative sampling has been further developed by CAPSTONE \cite{he2023capstone}, which addresses the training-inference discrepancy in dual-encoder dense retrieval. CAPSTONE expands documents with pseudo-queries during training and employs a curriculum sampling strategy that progressively improves the relevance between generated and real queries, effectively controlling negative difficulty through the query generation quality. This approach achieves strong results on both in-domain and out-of-domain retrieval benchmarks, reinforcing the finding that curriculum-based difficulty scheduling benefits dense retrieval training. While CAPSTONE focuses on bridging the training-inference gap through document expansion, our structure-grounded negatives provide an orthogonal form of curriculum: negatives that are hard because they do *not* share data-flow context with the positive (¬reachable_G(x,q)), not because of embedding proximity alone.

While CAPSTONE focuses on bridging the training-inference gap through document expansion, our structure-grounded negatives provide an orthogonal form of curriculum: negatives that are hard because they do *not* share data-flow context with the positive (¬reachable_G(x,q)), not because of embedding proximity alone.
